mission: Map the thin places along the Ruusan Corridor, assess the seal's deterioration on inhabited worlds, and track Veraine's trail.
why_now: The Ruusan Corridor sites are the logical investigative path toward Veranthos, and Veraine is moving along the same route. Evidence of her passage confirms the urgency.
conflict: Ben vs. growing evidence the problem is far larger than one wound site
turning_point: Recent markings in ancient ruins confirm someone has been through the Corridor ahead of them. Veraine's trail goes warm.
setting: Aboard Steady Returns; stops along the Ruusan Corridor
emotional_trajectory: The cover-up has real victims — ordinary people living with consequences they don't understand
notes: Multiple thin places mapped. Veraine's recent presence detected at one site. The cover-up's real-world cost visible in affected communities.
